data.body:
## Verbosity calibration — frozen historical sample

Population and exclusions: 610 task/story/bug/epic tickets with description length 7,200–7,999 or >=8,000 characters; session_log and code_review excluded. Length is Unicode character count of the compiled current description. Near=7,200–7,999; over>=8,000.

Selection is reproducible: seed `20260903-bloat-v1`; compute SHA-256(seed + ":" + canonical ticket id), rank within ticket_type×band, and take fixed quotas: bug 3 near/2 over, epic 2 near/3 over, story 3 near/2 over, task 2 near/3 over. Result: 20 unique tickets, five per type and ten per band.

Three independent blind-review batches contain eight tickets each. All share cibophobic-moist-guineafowl (bug/near/7,855) and uncheered-sombre-bumblebee (story/over/12,128) for agreement evidence; each batch then has six disjoint tickets. Full identifiers, assignments, and lengths are recorded on inanimate-unrideable-wasp.

Detector firings are computed separately and hidden from reviewers. Reviewers label overall bloat plus each rule's targeted construct as present/absent/NA. Per-rule confusion matrices exclude NA; union-of-rules is compared with overall bloat. Percentages use each rule's applicable ticket count. This intentionally oversamples long artifacts and cannot estimate prevalence in ordinary tickets.
